project: Revenue Tides — The Commercial Life of Games
phase: PHASE A.1 — PUBLIC RELEASE SOURCE RESOLUTION
recommended_project_title_zh: 付费潮汐——游戏商业生命线
recommended_scope: Official-disclosure-led game/IP/franchise revenue across mobile, PC, and console
mobile_only_feasibility: Narrowly feasible but materially weaker and publisher-concentrated

event_layer.causality_rule: Events are contemporaneous context or attributed claims only

public_release_assessment: Publish source-linked factual observations and transparent formulas; do not mirror decks, charts, or IR data feeds by default
disk_impact: Phase A.1 is text-only and well below 1 MB; a deduplicated controlled corpus should remain below roughly 250 MB even with selected official PDFs
conditions_before_phase_b: Explicitly approve the all-games title and scope
Freeze fiscal quarter as the primary temporal unit
Keep metric versions, entity types, platform scope, original currency, and reporting scope explicit
Label share-derived values DERIVED_FROM_OFFICIAL with formulas and uncertainty intervals
Publish structured facts and citations instead of copied IR slides or mirrored archives
Exclude unresolved Nexon franchise amounts from the quantitative backbone
Treat official events as period context rather than automatic causal proof
